_comment: The PLATFORM's half of lib/akasha/concepts/ (the purge order §4.2): the mechanism modules a platform-alone cell needs — the concept registry, society, source, workflow, workbench, lens, cronon and the rest named in platform_modules — declared here, in a platform-owned file, so removing every application-owned file (lib/akasha/concepts/MANIFEST.json included) leaves a cell that boots and serves them. An entry also present in the application's manifest is the platform's: the aggregator keeps this one and reports the other as shadowed until the application removes it.

r.desc: Remember — recall an atom by ID / alias / $ref

ln.desc: Link two nodes with a typed relation (quote multi-word names)

ln.rm.desc: Remove a typed link between two atoms

al.desc: Name an atom (multi-word: al $it first kiss)

al.rm.desc: Remove an alias binding (atom is not deleted)

al.find.desc: Find names matching a pattern (e.g. city%)

sim.desc: Atoms semantically like THIS atom (anchored on its own meaning; meta=1 to include lexicon defs)

search.desc: Semantic text search: search query=<text> (meta=1 to include lexicon defs)

semantic.learn.desc: Learn the content (meaning) model behind sim/search from the whole corpus (admin, numpy)

node.learn.desc: Learn structural (node-walk) embeddings from the link graph (admin, numpy)

node.sim.desc: Atoms structurally similar to THIS atom (connected the same way; meta=1 for lexicon defs)

exp.desc: Explore ontology by filter: ns=, set=, type=, pat= (positional = pat)

tree.desc: Link-traversal tree: tree <alias|key|set:*|ns:*> [depth=2] [follow=<rel>] [format=rich|ascii] [concept=yes → taxonomic concept (sys:is_a) tree; leaves=yes → show instances]

dive.desc: Dive into an atom — see its meaning space and signposts

out.desc: Zoom out to the macro view

view.desc: Consciousness view of an atom: signposts, resonance, cosmos position + aura (read-only, no dive)

wb.pin.desc: Pin a concept to active Whiteboard

horizon.add.desc: Add a set/concept to the session horizon (self-directed attention): horizon.add set=<name-or-concept> [mode=soft|lens]

horizon.rm.desc: Remove a set from the session horizon: horizon.rm set=<name>

horizon.mode.desc: Change a horizon entry's mode: horizon.mode set=<name> mode=soft|lens

horizon.ls.desc: List the session horizon ({set, mode, granted})

sess.state.desc: The normalized semantic session: identity / granted / self_directed (all client kinds, one shape)

macro.def.desc: Define a saved parameterized CSL macro: macro.def name= params="a=1,b=" script=…

macro.run.desc: Run a macro (extra key=vals bind its params): macro.run <name> [param=…] [as=inline]

locale.desc: Show / set priority locale  (locale  |  locale set <primary> [<l1>,<l2>,...])

csl.desc: Check + transpile + execute CSL (inline text or .csl file path)

csl.run.desc: Check, transpile and execute CSL as Harmonia job

cross.atom.desc: Find concept atoms referencing an ontology atom

dream.desc: Incubate hidden affinity bridges (async 'sleep on it'). dream id=<atom> → dreaming; call again → ready + candidates. boldness=/reach= tune; again=yes re-dreams.

dream.confirm.desc: Approve a staged dream bridge into a real link: dream.confirm dst=<atom> [src=<focus>]

nebula.desc: Survey accumulated atoms for regions becoming a concept model (async). nebula → surveying; call again → ready + candidate regions with proposed salient-rels. again=yes re-surveys.

nebula.confirm.desc: Approve a proposed region → plant its set + salient-rels and emit a concept-model skeleton: nebula.confirm id=<neb:…> name=<concept>

nebula.forget.desc: Drop a proposed region (or all): nebula.forget [id=<neb:…>] [all=yes]

cur.project.desc: Project a curation into a private presentation deck: cur.project id=<cur> as=presentation [title=]

pr.export.desc: Export a presentation as a self-contained artifact: pr.export id=<pres> as=scroll|kamishibai [inline=true|publish=<slug>]

io.import.desc: Import a file/upload into the graph: io.import path= | text= [format=] [table=]

io.export.desc: Export a table/set to a file or inline: io.export (table=|set=) path= | inline=true

io.index.desc: Index every supported file under a permitted dir: io.index dir= [exts=] [limit=]

io.project.desc: Project an in-graph source into a concept model (lens): io.project src= [model=] [into=]

io.ingest.desc: General raw-records import into ANY model: io.ingest model=<concept> (path=|text=|records=) [into=] [map=]

io.allow.desc: Permit a local directory for io.import/index/export/ingest

associate.desc: Gap detection: find missing semantic links for an atom (one level, no inference)

emotion.profile.desc: Emotion vector of an atom (the emotions it links to)

emo.prof.desc: Emotion vector of an atom (alias of emotion.profile)

emotion.find.desc: Atoms that FEEL an emotion: emotion.find emo=awe (reverse of emotion.profile)

emo.find.desc: Find atoms by emotion (alias of emotion.find)

ref.set.desc: Set typed context variable: ref.set who <atom>

horizon.enclose.desc: Persist the intersection of the current lens horizon entries (>=2) as a named set with provenance (write-gated): horizon.enclose name=<set>

cs.dx.desc: Diagnose pressure and arc-readiness of active Cast

cs.map.desc: Show full structure of active Cast

cs.react.desc: Simulate Cast's reaction to an event

cs.bond.desc: Create a relational bond to another cast atom

cs.bond.up.desc: Append a delta event to an existing bond

cs.clone.desc: Clone active Cast to a new named cast

cs.conflict.desc: Record a tension between two values/drives

cs.id.desc: Set identity text on active Cast

cs.myth.desc: Attach a mythic archetype and symbol

cs.role.desc: Assign a narrative role (e.g. Proppian function)

cs.secret.desc: Add a secret with protection score

lens.cast.desc: Project scanned nodes into chosen concept model: lens.cast signpost=1 [into=<name>]

lens.desc: Scan a set/tree and list compatible concept model targets: lens src=<set|key> [follow=<rel>] [depth=2] [within=<set>]

lens.compare.desc: Join two observation sets by item, compare labels (before/after): lens.compare a=<set> b=<set> [key=item] [field=label] [truth=<field>] [result=<atom>]

cli_groups.log: Exploration log — checkpoints, annotations, and replay
cli_groups.whiteboard: Concept pinboard for ideas under active exploration
